title: Delete the TypeScript reconciler
description:
Once a cloud epic runs through ticfac in the container, the isolate's reimplementation of the reconciler has no callers and should be deleted rather than maintained. Two implementations of one mechanism is what put us here: git-contents.ts and tracker-write.ts both wrote through GitHub's contents API and only one of them sent the branch, which is 99f - and that module's own header says 'Two consumers, one mechanism, so the rules cannot drift between them'.

Goes: epic-reconciler.ts, tracker-client.ts, git-contents.ts, tarball.ts and their tests.

Check before deleting each - some of this has other callers. tracker-write.ts serves the signal funnel and is NOT part of this. The RepoRoom publish slot and the RunRoom dispatch lease arbitrate between CONCURRENT RUNS of a project and stay. decisions/reconciler-parity.json describes a parity that will no longer have two sides; decide whether it is deleted or rewritten to say the hosts are now one implementation.

This tick is LAST on purpose. Nothing is deleted until the replacement has run an epic end to end on the deployed factory.
notes:
2026-09-22 15:15 - SANDBOX-EXECUTOR.TS IS NOT IN THE DELETE LIST, AND MUST NOT DRIFT INTO IT.

cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts (724 lines, from k4s) is the per-tick Sandbox
dispatch machinery: namedSandbox, findWorkProcess, and the handle-across-a-step-
boundary discipline. Its ONLY caller today is epic-reconciler.ts:1649
(sandboxExecutorFromEnv), which this tick deletes. So the moment mn7 lands, it is
orphaned code with no caller - which is exactly the shape that invites an implementer
reading 'every deleted module is confirmed to have no remaining caller' to delete it
too.

Do not. xte needs it: the Go orchestrator in the container cannot create a sibling
Sandbox directly (the binding is a Worker binding), so the container has to reach a
Worker endpoint over HTTP, and this module is the Worker side of that call. Deleting
it means rewriting it.

If xte has not yet given it a new caller when this tick runs, leave it in place with a
comment saying what it is waiting for, and say so in the tick's report.
acceptance_criteria: The isolate no longer implements a reconciler, every deleted module is confirmed to have no remaining caller, tracker-write.ts and the rooms are untouched, and the full suite passes
